facts.fact: The Companies and Intellectual Property Commission launched an upgraded Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Module giving law enforcement agencies real-time access to company ownership information, first launched in April 2023, per the dtic spokesperson.

CIPC launched its Optimized Beneficial Ownership Declaration functionality on 22 August 2025 and had received more than 23,000 declarations on it, with companies, external companies and close corporations required to submit beneficial ownership information annually or on change.
CIPC states external company registration is available only on its e-Services platform, with no manual or e-mail applications accepted, and is within 20 business days of starting activity.

note: Named only as a fintech and crypto market.
The page covers SARS tax and customs registration, not the companies register.

facts.fact: The CIPC says its automated Beneficial Ownership register, launched on 1 April 2023, had received more than 3.2 million filings by 27 May 2026, and that companies must submit an annual declaration of who owns or controls them.

note: The deck names business registration only as a third-party verification source for the Central Supplier Database; it states nothing on the register itself.

facts.fact: In a written reply the trade minister, citing the CIPC, said the CIPC beneficial ownership register held filings from 1,139,011 of 2,297,242 active private companies (49.58%) as at 22 September 2025, with access limited to law enforcement and competent authorities.

note: Nothing on a business register for South Africa.
